newsitem.title: RUSSIA: U.S. rating agency to visit Moscow Monday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rating agency to visit Moscow Monday.

text.p: A U.S. rating agency will arrive in Moscow on Monday to draw up a credit rating for Russia's first eurobond issue, a senior Russian official said on Friday.
"They are coming and it is not the first rating agency," deputy finance minister Oleg Vyugin told Reuters. "One agency has already visited Moscow, now another one is coming."
He refused to name the agencies, or say when the first agency had come.
"It is only the beginning," Vyugin said. "At the end of September everything will be ready and published."
Russia is planning to launch its first Eurobond issue at the end of September or start of October.

Russia agreed in principle with the London Club of commercial bank creditors to reschedule $35 billion of debt last year, paving the way for the Eurobond. Individual banks are now signing up to the deal.
